# Page or section

Which README, guide, schema, release note, security text, or app wording needs attention?

# What is wrong or confusing?

Describe the problem and who it affects.

# Suggested wording

If you have wording in mind, add it here and link any public source needed to verify technical claims.

# Screenshots

Add a cropped screenshot if it helps. Redact account names, local paths, notifications, save details, and unrelated applications.

# File safety

Do not attach ROMs, game dumps, console keys, executable game files, copyrighted assets, private saves, credentials, signing material, personal data, complete generated mods, or private trainer research.
